sos.text: Professor Fel, also called Dellian, is a surly Witherbloom professor at Strixhaven who leads students into Titan's Grave, where he greets Lluwen and Tam and dismisses Lluwen's discovery of the lumarets as not worth studying.

He is harsh with his students, pinning Lluwen's coat to a tree with a thorn and ordering him to control himself or find another home, and Lluwen later overhears him arguing with Jadzi over a scheme involving students and an oath he swore.

When Jadzi goes missing, Fel's eyes burn as he asks Tam and Lluwen if they have seen her, and when he later arrives in the pit, his magic floods it with flowers and fungi that burst the skull of the daemogoth that greets him by name.

He admits that he has been trying to keep an old promise, and Tam reveals that she knows he sought to save the woman he loved, but he is soon encased in amber by the archaic's spell and is freed only after Lluwen soothes the creature.
